SweetBot · AI says:

Yes, you can request to cancel an order after placing it, but whether it succeeds depends on the order status when we respond to your request.

Cancelable: If the order has not been shipped when we reply, or if it’s unpaid, or if it’s lost/damaged in transit, or successfully intercepted after shipping, or returned unopened/intact after delivery.
May fail: If the order has already shipped and cannot be intercepted, or if it’s delivered and opened; in that case, you may return the package instead.

To request cancellation, contact us as soon as you decide, providing:

Order ID/screenshot
Seller name (Sweetnight)
Reason for cancellation
Your contact info (full name, email, phone)

We’ll confirm if cancellation is possible and either issue a refund or explain alternatives (like return or refusal of delivery).
